title: First preparation step
statement: For every natural number $k$ and Boolean words $w,s$, one step of the specified preparation machine from its scan configuration at position $|s|$ gives its ready configuration in state $1$, with the flag recording whether $|w|<|s|$ and the first work-tape head at $|s|-1$.
